summary: holes3-rows.mjs rebuilt holes.json byte-identically from the committed raw results (all 91 status assertions pass), all 303 cited case ids exist in holes3-results/final.json, no refusal sentence has engine words or more than one sentence, and 44 live replays plus new probes (scale 0.4 to 4000 mm, near-tangent walls to 5e-6, edge/face-touching repeats, countersink band on 6 host kinds) found no silent wrong solid. Only minor defects: wide curved-host tolerance, three supported recess cases with a closed form as the only independent measure, one OCCT-only supported case.

replays.feature: new probes: scale 0.4..4000 mm, tiny bore 0.05/0.5 across, 0.05 mm plate, wall 5e-6..5e-3, rotated-slab tangent, repeat edge/face touch, 32 countersink-band cases over box/cylinder/pad/hex/join/x-axis/moved/hollow
replays.command: bun critic-holes/myrun.mjs (copy of holes3-run.mjs, own cases) vs live OCCT, brep-rs, closed form
replays.live: all built cases within 2e-4 of OCCT/closed form (tiny bores: removed volume 4.9% low from mesh volume only, host volume 8e-8); every band case below the cone-tool depth refused with a plain sentence

defects.problem: okBuilt accepts removed-volume error up to 3e-4 of the host volume on curved hosts, about 5% of a 339 mm3 countersink on a 60x20 cylinder. Observed errors are 0.3 to 1.2% (cs-in-cylinder-blind dRemoved 7.2e-3, cb-in-cylinder-blind 3.0e-3, cyl-3.4 replay 1.2e-2) and agree with brep-rs to 2.4e-5 of host, so the data is tighter than the bar.
Only independent measure is the closed form: brep-rs refuses and OCCT ignores the recess. Removed volume matches to 3.4e-4, 7e-5 and 7e-5; no topology oracle.

Supported with OCCT as the only oracle (brep-rs refuses, no closed form stored) and timing is borderline against the 30 s CPU policy (runs 22.0 to 27.7 s; the 45-degree case ran 47.3 s once, median 30.9 s). The row discloses both.

Tangency is guarded only against bbox sides and other bores (absolute 1e-6 tolerance, not scale-relative); tangency to interior pocket and notch walls is built unguarded. Volumes agree with OCCT, brep-rs and closed form to 6e-6 here, and the row states the gap, but untested at other scales or on turned hosts.

holes4-* scripts exist in contract/ with no holes4-results and no link to holes.json (holes.json is built by holes3-rows.mjs). RIG.md holes section still documents round 1 (holes-drive/holes-rows, 78 rows) and its command does not reproduce the committed 91-row file; the right command is in the round-3 paragraph at RIG.md line 160.
